The issuer demonstrates solid profitability with a net income of $403 million on $2.11 billion in revenue, alongside a healthy retained earnings base of $4.18 billion. However, the balance sheet reflects high leverage with total liabilities of $17.38 billion against $21.78 billion in total assets (a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of ~80% and a debt-to-equity ratio around 5.2x), which is characteristic of a highly leveraged financial institution or large capital-intensive company. Overall, the combination of adequate earning power and significant leverage supports an investment-grade rating in the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB
